title: Nick Sirianni Press Conference: October 24, 2026
headline: DeVonta Smith's hamstring remains unresolved with no clear plan. Makai Lemon is set to be featured against Dallas, and Tanner McKee is confirmed as the No. 2 QB.
summary: Sirianni spoke ahead of Monday Night Football against the Cowboys, with the team struggling and the coach saying everything is "on the table." He said the extra day this week allowed for self-scouting and that the staff has adjusted schemes, schedules and practice, without giving specifics. He praised rookie TE Eli Stowers for a good week of practice, saying he looks fast and athletic and that the team needs everyone to develop. Marquise Brown was described as a true professional with great speed who made a standout catch in practice, but Sirianni gave no sign his playing time will increase. Makai Lemon got the strongest endorsement: Sirianni wants to get him the ball, calls him a playmaker and says his ceiling is very high, though the usage depends on how the game unfolds. Asked whether DeVonta Smith might be shut down because of his lingering hamstring problem, Sirianni did not commit either way. He said only "we'll see where that goes" and praised Smith's preparation. He credited Tanner McKee's growth and focus for becoming the No. 2 QB, and said the team is learning more about its other backup QBs.

injuries.detail: A reporter asked about shutting him down because of a hamstring issue lingering since the summer. Sirianni did not rule it in or out, only saying the team will see where it goes.
The reporter framed him as back compared to the summer. Sirianni gave no injury details and said only that he had a nice week of practice.

signals.claim: Lemon will be a featured target in the game plan against Dallas, with the team looking to get him the ball.
signals.note: Sirianni called him a playmaker and wants him involved, which matters most if Smith is limited or out.
signals.quote: we want to get him the football. We know he's one of our playmakers.

signals.note: The hamstring issue has lingered since the summer and Sirianni gave no clear plan, so his status needs monitoring.

signals.claim: McKee is the No. 2 quarterback behind Jalen Hurts.
signals.note: He is the first man up if Hurts is hurt, which gives him value to handcuff.
signals.quote: Tanner didn't budge, you know. He didn't blink.

signals.note: Sirianni praised his attitude and talent but gave no commitment to more playing time, so he stays a speculative stash.

signals.claim: Stowers will be part of the group the team needs to contribute going forward.
signals.note: The praise is general and there is no stated role, so he is only worth monitoring for now.

topics.detail: Sirianni said the extra day allowed for self-scouting and that schemes, schedules and practice have all been adjusted, though he stayed general. He said the team's core values stay the same.

Sirianni said the team is losing more than its young players are used to. He compared it to his own 2-5 start in 2021 and said the focus is on process, learning from adversity and the length of an NFL season. He noted receivers must adjust to tighter coverage and more contested catches.
Sirianni said the team is learning more about its other quarterbacks as they take scout-team and developmental reps. He described them as having different skill sets and good athleticism.
